from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Case(BaseModel):
    """Captures the key factual and legal information from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The official title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or legal claim as stated in the document (e.g., '不履行法定职责', '离婚财产纠纷')")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain of the case (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Maritime', 'Criminal')")
    dispute_subject: str = Field(description="The specific subject matter or issue type of the dispute (e.g., 'Payment/Compensation', 'Execution', 'Property Division')")
    key_entities: list[str] = Field(description="Named entities relevant to the legal relationship, such as parties or organizations (e.g., 'Housing Provident Fund Center', 'Defendant Government')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted case instances from the document collection."""
    cases: list[Case]
